# Credit Shortage Automation Process - QA

> Converted from the source PDF. API endpoints, verification steps, and sample data are preserved. Original page snapshots are embedded at the end for visual reference.

## 1. Validate Open Invoices

Run the Open Invoices API:

```text
http://finance-credit-shortageautomation.stage.ashleyfurniture.com/replacementinvoice/api/OpenInvoices/runs
```

## 2. Validate Credit Memo Availability

Validate whether any credit memo is available for the created replacement invoice `72616352`:

```text
http://afiqua.ashleyfurniture.com:10010/web/services/credit_memo_shortage_credit_validation
```

## 3. Verify RA Availability

Verify RA availability for the created replacement invoice:

```text
http://afiqua.ashleyfurniture.com:10010/web/services/credit_memo_shortage_ra_validation
```

## 4. Validate Replacement Invoice Data

Call the microservice to validate replacement invoice data:

```text
https://finance-credit-shortageautomation.stage.ashleyfurniture.com/creditvalidation/api/ShortageValidation/validate-credit-shortage
```

## 5. Create the Shortage Entry

Call the entry API to create the shortage against the replacement invoice:

```text
https://finance-credit-shortage-automation.stage.ashleyfurniture.com/creditprocessinvoice/api/ProcessInvoiceItem/process-credit-entry
```

Perform verification both **before** and **after** calling the entry API.

## 6. Submit and Verify the Transaction

1. Run the Submit API.
2. Verify the `tblCreditShortageTransaction` table.

## 7. Auto-Approve the Shortage Credit Memo

Call the auto-approve API and verify that a shortage credit memo is created for the replacement invoice:

```text
https://finance-credit-shortage-automation.stage.ashleyfurniture.com/credit-shortage-approval/api/CreditShortageApproval/auto-approve
```

### Database verification

- Verify the relevant tables.
- Verify the `rahApplyCd` and `rahAprDny` columns.
- Compare the application state **before approval** and **after approval**.

## 8. Merge Credit Data to DB2 (AS400)

Call the `merge-credit-db2` API. This merges the data with DB2 (AS400):

```text
https://finance-credit-shortage-automation.stage.ashleyfurniture.com/mergetodb2/api/CreditMerge/merge-credit-db2
```

## 9. Scheduler Verification

### Before triggering the scheduler

Verify Stage AD. The following invoices are not shown:

| Order | Job ID | Customer | Ship To | Warehouse | Trip # | Order Mode | Order Type | Invoice |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---:|
| D254730 | 15 202607150732112 | 1256500 | 2104 | 15 | 50993 | EC | Blank | 72616369 |
| D254733 | 15 202607150732113 | 1256500 | 2104 | 15 | 50995 | EC | Blank | 72616373 |
| D254735 | 15 202607150732114 | 1256500 | 2104 | 15 | 50994 | EC | Blank | 72616372 |
| D254734 | 1 202607180732118 | 1256500 | 49 | 1 | 50998 | EC | Blank | 72616367 |
| D254738 | 1 202607180732117 | 1256500 | 49 | 1 | 50996 | EC | Blank | 72616365 |
| D254742 | 1 202607180732119 | 1256500 | 49 | 1 | 50997 | EC | Blank | 72616366 |

### After running the scheduler

Verify the invoices created for:

- **Customer:** `1256500`
- **Ship To:** `49`
- **Invoice:** `72616366`
